purpose: Bound current-f01e AutoRound TP4/MTP3/eager/F16 at exact 8K against the just-passed same-topology TP4/MTP0 oracle. Require exact target parity, isolated positive and conserved speculative counters, objective quality with all 16 cache-zero usages, four-worker topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup before any strong interpretation.

parent_oracle.gate: The parent must remain terminal state passed-quality-clean-tp4-oracle-sentinel with exact depth, objective quality, TP4 topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup true. Compare all 128 MTP3 candidate token IDs with this frozen same-topology output; mismatch is a quarantine, not a comparison caveat.

historical_context.e9d_tp4_mtp3: The isolated-cache e9d TP4/MTP3 screen booted and measured 31.1680 conventional tok/s with 149/210 draft tokens accepted. It is historical context only and supplies no speed floor, oracle, quality authority, or current-f01e selector transfer.
historical_context.old_shared_cache_failure: The earlier concurrent shared-cache TP4 failure is infrastructure-invalid and is not evidence that TP4/MTP3 is unsupported.

exact_depth_contract.gate: Exact active prompt depth 8192, cache zero, 128 returned token IDs, and every helper exact-depth check must pass.

acceptance_contract.snapshot_scope: Snapshot both speculative counters immediately before and after only the exact-8K request, with no intervening traffic.
acceptance_contract.gate: Both before and after counters must exist and be finite; deltas must be positive and conserved: drafted_delta > 0, accepted_delta > 0, accepted_delta <= drafted_delta, and neither cumulative counter may decrease.

quality_contract.objective_pass: quality.json pass_all plus explicit prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens == 0 for every usage across seven exact cases, all eight repeat runs, and the long-context case; missing telemetry fails closed
quality_contract.comparison_gate: baseline_match_all must pass against the frozen same-topology TP4/MTP0 quality receipt.
quality_contract.gate: Objective quality, all 16 cache-zero usage records, and all 24 same-topology baseline comparisons must pass.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Exact depth, exact same-topology target parity, isolated positive/conserved acceptance, objective quality, all 16 cache-zero records, all 24 baseline comparisons, TP4 topology, identity, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup pass.
terminal_classification.quarantined-target-parity-failed: Exact depth and acceptance pass but any of the 128 output IDs differs from the frozen TP4/MTP0 oracle; preserve lower-grade evidence without publication or descendant authority.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact depth passes but isolated speculative counters are absent, non-positive, decreasing, or violate accepted <= drafted; preserve lower-grade evidence.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Mechanism gates pass but objective quality, cache-zero completeness, or same-topology baseline comparison fails; preserve lower-grade evidence.
terminal_classification.quarantined-exact-depth-failed: The exact 8K gate fails; preserve lower-grade evidence.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an explicit exact-image native-MTP unsupported line qualifies.
terminal_classification.failed: Startup, binding, topology, identity, metrics, rank-cache, cleanup, or harness failure.

cache_contract.policy: vLLM rank_<rank>_0 namespaces under one fresh ext4 root; graph-off expects no compile artifacts, otherwise require all four rank namespaces and no shared compile files
